mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy supports valuation multiples.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 260.0 indicates accelerating inflation, triggering hawkish policy expectations that depress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 260.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal broad consumer demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS both decline, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 7.5%), a declining unemployment rate signals labor market recovery that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 7.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly payroll growth above 100,000 (PAYEMS) indicates labor market strength that supports consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 100,000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100.0 signals manufacturing contraction, triggering equity sell-offs that produce negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth above 2.0% (GDPC1) indicates robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth > 2.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous FEDFUNDS increases and CPIAUCSL declines signal successful disinflation without recession, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases and CPIAUCSL decreases from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL falls, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
